hypothesis: Interleaving confidence-anchored whole-native-tree inference with genomic TV correction improves local ancestry accuracy and transition fidelity beyond the same tree and TV operators applied in blocked order.
method: Two52-scalar FP32 arms compute (BA)^3 or B^3 A^3.
